design: Enable native interpolation only for the controllable actor hierarchy; the scene root opts out so render-driven ships and source props retain their existing playback.
Keep ground movement and jump height on physics ticks. R1 facing and crop offsets use Sprite3D.offset geometry without changing the interpolated transform.
R0 keeps interpolated Visual jump height and uses a separate non-interpolated Facing child for immediate flips.
Pausing disables actor interpolation and snaps to the inspected state. Resume, reset, raw preview and F4 restoration reset interpolation history.
Source animation frame counts, durations and PNGs are unchanged. This smooths movement, not the 10 FPS locomotion pose sequence.
notes: Official documentation informs the implementation; pixel readback tests establish actual behavior in the installed engine.
Native 60 TPS and stress 10 TPS use the same actual key input and rendered marker hierarchy.
Original skill attachment/dispatch and original engine animation speed multipliers are still not recovered.
